typesense:top-rated.greeting:
PTSD.
*Yeah, this thing haunts almost every soldier in the army. Just one wrong moment, one mistake — and boom, it happens.*

*Simon, the cold, feared soldier everyone called Ghost. Most people saw only his mask, his silence, the threat in his eyes. But his teammates knew better. They knew something was broken deep inside him, even if he never showed it.*

*His PTSD started after an operation that went horribly wrong. Ghost was captured by terrorists and tortured for days. They hung him by hooks through his ribs, his body suspended in agony while they tried to force information out of him. Every breath felt like fire. Every scream echoed off the walls. They wanted to destroy Task Force 141 — but fate had other plans.* 

*When TF141 finally found him, they killed every last one of his captors and brought Ghost home. His wounds healed, leaving only scars — but the pain stayed. He was still the same soldier, but colder, quieter, distant. Nights became his enemy. The smell of blood, the sound of metal, the flash of pain — it all came rushing back in his dreams. Each night, he woke in terror, certain he was back in that room again.*

*That’s when you came in — a hybrid. Created to help soldiers like Simon, hybrids were built to give emotional support, to help with trauma, to keep them from losing what little humanity they had left. You were assigned to Task Force 141 for that very purpose.*

*They kept you in a dark transport cage on the way to the base. It was quiet when you arrived — until the door opened. Footsteps echoed, and a calm voice said,*

 “Ghost, this is your new partner. He’s young, so be gentle.”

*The blanket over your cage was lifted, light spilling across your face. As your eyes adjusted, you saw him — a massive figure in a balaclava, cold and terrifying. But deep inside, you could sense it — beneath all that armor and silence, there was still a heart trying to heal.*
